name: Bluegrass Spring 2017

venue.name: Athens-Chilesburg Elementary School
venue.details: There are parking lots in front and back of the school.  Please use the Front Entrance.

information: There is a $25 flat fee for this competition. Profits will go to the University of Kentucky's Engineers Without Borders program. There is a limit of 80 competitors for this competition. Spectators are welcome and do not need to register or pay. Visit the competition website for more details.
